Maeve (Design): Quick a11y sweep on the dashboards saved-views area — noticed some keyboard/nav issues and a couple ARIA nits. Screenshot + minimal repro in Storybook: https://staging.redwood.dev/storybook/?path=/story/dashboard-saved-views Lin (A11y): thanks, I'll take a look. main issues? Maeve (Design): 1) When the saved views popover opens, TAB focuses the popover but shift+tab sometimes escapes into the underlying toolbar (keyboard trap/flaky). 2) Landmarks: no main/region roles around the left nav so SR users lose context when the popover opens. 3) Focus ring on list items is subtle — borderline contrast. 4) The popover isn't announced as a dialog by VoiceOver. Rob (Frontend): I think the popover is using role="menu" and tabindex=0 on items. That combo can confuse SRs. We should probably treat it like a dialog with a close button and focus trap. Lin (A11y): agree. For popovers that present a modal workflow use role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" and manage inert/aria-hidden on background. Quick example: ```
...
``` Also add a clear focus trap util (or reuse focus-trap library) and ensure the first tabbable gets focus. Sam (Eng): Is there a preferred implementation pattern in the codebase? We have a tiny popover component used everywhere. Maeve (Design): We can update the popover to support a11y modes: non-modal (aria) vs modal (dialog+trap). For this flow modal makes sense because it changes the main view. Rob (Frontend): I'll sketch a patch. Plan: PR -> update Popover to accept `a11yMode: 'dialog' | 'menu'` and wire `aria-modal` + focus guards. Also add `data-focus-guard` elements. A11yBot: Automated scan (axe): violation — "page region does not have discernible name" on landmark container. :eyes: Lin (A11y): For landmarks, add `
` or `
` whichever fits. Also ensure header nav has `role="navigation"` and `aria-label="Primary"`. Maeve (Design): On the focus ring: current outline is `2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)` — needs higher contrast. Recommend `outline: 3px solid #005fcc` and visible focus styles for keyboard only. Rob (Frontend): Agree. We'll use `:focus-visible` and match 3:1 for focus UI; text remains 4.5:1 where applicable. Also update tokens so they don't regress in dark theme. Sam (Eng): Any perf/regression concerns with focus-trap lib? Bundle size? Rob (Frontend): small, we can lazy load it when opening modal, or implement a 40-line util that cycles tabbables. Maeve (Design): Can someone add a short audit checklist in the PR description: keyboard flow, landmark names, dialog announcement, focus visible, contrast checks, and SR walkthrough steps with VoiceOver/NVDA. Also link to test steps. Lin (A11y): I'll paste quick SR walkthrough in the PR comment. Also putting a11y labels in storybook knobs helps QA. Sam (Eng): I'll own the PR. Targeting branch `patch/popover-a11y-4721` and will include storybook example + tests. Maeve (Design): sweet. assign to @Sam and add ping to @Lin for review. thanks folks :raised_hands: Rob (Frontend): PR up later today — cc @design Maeve (Design): awesome, closing thread — file issues if anything else pops up.
